reissue: Re-issue of r20261001-02 from the same sealed raw set (manifest sha256 unchanged); no run was repeated. spec.question: Do the journeys catch prefix sabotage? NC1 = per-request timestamp in the system message (acceptance gate 2); NC2 = stored prompt treated stale on every fresh agent plus a per-build nonce (#104414 shape).
spec.falsifier: any journey still passing under NC1 or NC2
